title: Boat Cover for Trailer Boats 17–19 ft – 600 × 310 cm in 600D Fabric
seo_title: Boat Cover for Trailer Boats 17–19 ft – 600 × 310 cm
seo_description: Boat cover in black 600D fabric for trailer boats 17–19 ft, 600 × 310 cm. Straps with adjustable buckles and an elastic hem hold the cover in place.
descriptionHtml:
The deck takes leaves, bird droppings and rain all winter on the trailer

The boat stays on the trailer from the end of the season until it's launched again, and the deck meets leaves, bird droppings and rain week after week with nothing covering it. The cushions are just as exposed, and spring starts with scraping and rinsing before the boat even gets in the water.

A 600D fabric cover, 600 × 310 cm, goes over the whole boat

The black 600D fabric cover goes over the boat on the trailer and measures 600 × 310 cm. Straps with adjustable buckles and an elastic hem hold it in place around the hull.

Features

  • The deck and cushions don't have to stand in the open air all winter – the 600D fabric cover, 600 × 310 cm, goes over the whole boat on the trailer.
  • Fits boats between 17 and 19 ft – the cover's dimensions, 600 × 310 cm, are set for that size class.
  • Stays in place around the hull in windy weather – straps with adjustable buckles and an elastic hem hold it in place.
  • Discreet black color on the trailer – the cover is sewn in black 600D fabric.

 

The boat is not included, only the cover.

Our guarantee

14 days to change your mind – if you don't like it, you get your money back. Tracked delivery and secure checkout. 🦫
